question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed experimental Claw package, provenance, and cross-owner lifecycle contract as the direction for the linked OpenClaw and ClawHub implementation stacks?
rationale: The proposal adds a new portable-agent product model, command surface, experimental gate, and interoperability contract; correctness of prose alone cannot determine whether this is desired platform direction.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental RFC
options.body: Accept the Claw direction in principle and designate reviewers to constrain the staged OpenClaw and ClawHub landing contracts.

options.title: Request a narrower RFC
options.body: Retain the portable-agent goal but reduce the initial contract to the boundaries maintainers are prepared to support experimentally.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Leave the RFC open without adoption until there is ownership and priority for the linked implementation stack.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental RFC
recommendation.body: Accept the Claw direction in principle and designate reviewers to constrain the staged OpenClaw and ClawHub landing contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current proposal and can incorporate an explicit maintainer decision, though a repository product owner must make the final direction call.
